Who We Are

A nationally experienced operator, built for growth.

Priority Life Care is a nationally experienced operator with a track record of revenue and NOI growth. From middle-market to high-end private-pay Independent Living, Assisted Living, and Memory Care communities, PLC works alongside residents to achieve the outcomes they want.

We offer the highest quality of amenities and services — giving residents the right choices for overall wellness and independence.

Where We Are

64 Communities. 12 States. One Mission.

At Priority Life Care, we believe everyone deserves dignity, compassion, and respect. Our communities are built around that belief — a safe, maintenance-free place to live so residents can pursue their hobbies and enjoy their retirement years.

How It Started

In 2009, the Petras family founded Priority Life Care to offer senior living for all financial backgrounds.

Sevy and Bobby Petras pioneered assisted living and memory care options that were rare at the time. Their motto: "Lighting the Way in Senior Care." Today, PLC serves over 4,000 residents, continuing that mission.

2009
Lamp Light turnaround portfolio in Fort Wayne, IN gives way to the birth of Priority Life Care. Expanded reach initially through managed communities with capital partners spanning Medicaid, middle market, private pay, and new development lease-ups.
2021
Awarded 17 managed communities with Ventas on a turnaround portfolio. PLC's performance led to additional growth — 32 properties managed for Ventas today.
2023
Launched back-office services support for Accounting, Finance, and Facilities management to other operators.
2024
Grown to over 64 managed communities. Given the profitability of the management company, PLC is seizing the current real-estate cycle by launching a fund and growing new Joint Ventures.

Mission

To compassionately light the way in senior care, with respect, to affordability and independence.

Technology & Software

Institutional-quality technology, applied to senior living.

TSO Life

Leading resident engagement software offering insights into residents' lives to support personalized programs and engagement. Piloting a Care platform with input from Priority Life Care.

Safely You

A dedicated strategic partner focused on fall detection and prevention — resulting in fewer resident falls (40%) and fewer trips to the ER (80%).

Prime Care Technologies

PrimeView provides insight into multiple platforms (financial, e-call, labor, census, and more) so management can run the business at its highest potential.

Toi Labs

Creator of the world's first AI toilet seat, which scans for health and wellness variations and relays concerning changes to care staff so they can intervene early.

Marketing

Award-winning digital, branding, and PR.

Partnered with Digital Wolf Agency — an industry-leading, full-service digital agency — across market analysis, lead generation, branding, events, media, PR, and direct marketing.

Case Studies

Numbers, not adjectives.

Five portfolios. Five different situations — a turnaround, a lease-up, a joint venture. The same disciplined playbook every time.

Case Study 01

Northeast 17 Portfolio

17 communities · Pennsylvania & West Virginia

+$12.5M NOI growth

Awarded management in December 2021 on a portfolio 20–40+ years old and in need of a capex refresh. Eliminated $2.4M in agency staffing, drove a 20% occupancy increase, and grew NOI from $1.3M to $13.8M.

Case Study 02

Poets Walk — 3 Pack

3 all-Memory-Care communities · Virginia & Texas

258% NOI growth

Awarded management in April 2022. Improved occupancy through professional referral relationships and sales execution, while tightening labor alignment to occupancy and acuity — NOI grew from $1.16M to $4.16M at a 28% margin.

Case Study 03

Celebration Villa of Loyalsock

Montoursville, PA · Standalone Assisted Living, built 1999

1,827% NOI growth

Completed a $560K FF&E renovation across 13,500 sqft of common area. Occupancy climbed from 73.7% to 90.0%, and NOI grew from $58K to $1.1M.

Case Study 04

Valparaiso, IN — Lease-Up

97-unit Assisted Living / Memory Care

96% occupied

Hired by Focus Healthcare Partners to manage a ground-up lease-up. Underwent a gut renovation, opened December 2021, reached 80%+ occupancy in 16 months, and is now fully leased with a 7%+ rate increase producing $1.9M+ at 30%+ margin.

Case Study 05

Riverview, FL — Joint Venture Turnaround

101-unit Assisted Living / Memory Care · JV with AEW

+29% T3 NOI growth

Entered a joint venture with AEW in April 2024. Netted 17+ residents in 9 months — NOI already up 29% before an 8%+ rate increase executed in January 2025.
